answer: Locks are logged in echo, expire in bridge, and wander lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 30 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A hostile operator running 62 aliases thus needs 61 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3394 identities would post 1027 proofs and burn roughly 85 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
